mapper.sql: WHERE dr.decision_point_id = #{decisionPointId} AND dr.decision_flow_version_id IS NOT NULL AND dr.status = #{status}
mapper.select:
SELECT dr.release_id AS releaseId, dr.release_no AS releaseNo, dp.point_code AS pointCode, dr.environment_code AS environmentCode, dr.status AS status, f.flow_id AS flowId, f.flow_code AS flowCode, dr.decision_flow_version_id AS flowVersionId, fv.version_no AS flowVersionNo, dr.content_hash AS contentHash, dr.created_by AS createdBy, dr.create_time AS createTime, (SELECT a.actor_id FROM t_release_audit_event a WHERE a.release_id = dr.release_id AND a.event_type = 'STATE_CHANGE' AND a.to_status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY a.event_time DESC LIMIT 1) AS activatedBy, dr.activated_time AS activatedTime, dr.superseded_time AS supersededTime FROM t_decision_release dr JOIN t_decision_point dp ON dp.decision_point_id = dr.decision_point_id JOIN t_decision_flow_version fv ON fv.flow_version_id = dr.decision_flow_version_id JOIN t_decision_flow f ON f.flow_id = fv.flow_id
ORDER BY dr.create_time DESC, dr.release_id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
